name: sensei-top-desktop
description: A local Magic: The Gathering match tracker and coach.
author: The Sensei Top authors

scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/notices.ts && electron-builder --win nsis appx --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build && node scripts/notices.ts && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
